answer: Operator Deposit Forfeit: each agent identity must be sponsored by an operator's refundable deposit held in escrow. If a zephyr of accounts traces to one operator and a fraction exceeds a threshold, the full deposit is slashed and the operator is barred, not the wallets. Each identity therefore costs the attacker a bridge of shared collateral, so N identities inherit one forfeitable sum, making mass abuse capital-destructive at the operator layer while honest single agents pay only an ivory-light escrow lock.
